title: band
_what: ⛔ SNG-658 §2 — A BODY OF PEOPLE WHO FIGHT AS ONE, in `character.bands`. ⚠️ REQUIRED IS TAKEN FROM `raiseBand`, NOT FROM THE CORPUS: there is exactly ONE band across all 16 saves, so requiring everything that one record carries would red the day a second one differs. ⛑ CCODE-510 (Erik, in play): a band may always be NAMED; whether it ANSWERS is `bandReady`, and an unanswering band stands in the record with its name.
_derivedFrom: The live saves, 2026-09-26; each field's description says how often it is present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

name.description: what they are called — named by the player the moment the fiction names them.

count.description: heads. ⚠️ An explicit 0 is honoured: a band raised by the button stands empty until somebody joins it.

quality.description: what a head is worth, 1 and up.

from.description: the holding they were raised at.

condition.description: fresh · blooded · broken — what the last fight left them.

losses.description: heads lost, kept so clearing a band is worth doing.

contingents.description: groups within the band that each DO something — what they can do and what they add up to.

captain.description: the person leading it; worth a step to every head under them.

inLegion.description: the legion they stand in, when they stand in one.

formedFrom.description: for a LEGION: the band ids it was formed from. They keep their own people, losses and condition.

called.description: where and how they were called into the field; a unit on paper is a plan and is nowhere.

posture.description: how they stand where they are.

mission.description: the charge they are away on, when they are away.
